questions.text: स्तंभ तिथे ना कुणी बांधला, पेटली न वात !
questions.answer: देशासाठी बलिदान देणाऱ्या सैनिकाचे स्मारक कोठेही बांधले गेले नाही किंवा त्याच्या स्मृतीप्रित्यर्थ दिवा लावला गेला नाही, म्हणून कवींनी असे म्हटले आहे.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: कवींनी असे का म्हटले असावे, असे तुम्हांला वाटते?
questions.text: जळावयास्तव संसारातून उठोनिया जाशी !
questions.answer: सैनिक आपल्या कुटुंबाचा त्याग करून, संसाराचा मोह सोडून देशाच्या रक्षणासाठी सीमेवर जातो आणि स्वतःचे बलिदान देतो, म्हणून कवींनी असे म्हटले आहे.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: कवींनी असे का म्हटले असावे, असे तुम्हांला वाटते?
questions.text: सफल जाहले तुझेच हे रे तुझेच बलिदान !
questions.answer: सैनिकाच्या बलिदानामुळेच आपला देश स्वतंत्र आणि सुरक्षित राहिला आहे, त्याच्या त्यागामुळेच आपण शांततेत जगत आहोत, म्हणून त्याचे बलिदान सफल झाले आहे असे कवी म्हणतात.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: देशासाठी प्राणापर्ण केलेला सैनिक 'अनाम' राहिला आहे, असे कवींना वाटते, त्याची कारणे लिहा.
questions.answer: १) त्याच्या नावाची कुठेही नोंद नाही. २) त्याचे कुठेही स्मारक बांधले गेले नाही. ३) कुणीही त्याच्यासाठी अश्रू ढाळले नाहीत. ४) त्याच्या विजयाचा जयजयकार झाला नाही.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: 'अ' गट आणि 'ब' गट यांच्या योग्य जोड्या जुळवा.
pairs: निर्भयपणे, मनात कोणतीही आसक्ती न ठेवता

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: खालील शब्दांचा तुम्हांला समजलेला अर्थ लिहा.
questions.text: अनाम वीर
questions.answer: ज्याचे नाव कोणालाही माहित नाही असा शूर सैनिक.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: खालील शब्दांचा तुम्हांला समजलेला अर्थ लिहा.
questions.text: जीवनान्त
questions.answer: आयुष्याचा शेवट किंवा मृत्यू.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: खालील शब्दांचा तुम्हांला समजलेला अर्थ लिहा.
questions.text: रेखेच्या रेषा
questions.answer: चेहऱ्यावरील भावनांच्या खुणा किंवा रेषा.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: खालील शब्दांचा तुम्हांला समजलेला अर्थ लिहा.
questions.text: मृत्युंजय वीर
questions.answer: मृत्यूवर विजय मिळवणारा शूर योद्धा.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: आजीने काव्यप्रतिभा वाढवण्याचा सांगितलेला अर्थ.
questions.answer: कविता करण्याची शक्ती वाढवणे.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: सुधीरची काव्यप्रतिभा वाढवण्यासाठी कुटुंबाने केलेली मदत.
questions.answer: सुधीरची काव्यप्रतिभा वाढवण्यासाठी कुटुंबातील सर्वजण त्याच्याशी कवितेत बोलू लागले.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: बाबांनी सुधीरला कवितांची पुस्तके आणून देण्याचे कारण.
questions.answer: सुधीरला कवितांचा संग्रह करता यावा आणि त्याची काव्यप्रतिभा वाढावी यासाठी बाबांनी त्याला पुस्तके आणून दिली.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: कुटुंबातील सदस्यांनी सुधीरचे अभिनंदन करण्याचे कारण.
questions.answer: सुधीरने काव्यप्रतिभा वाढवण्याचा प्रकल्प अतिशय उत्साहाने आणि चांगल्या प्रकारे पूर्ण केला म्हणून.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: पाठातील 'कवितेतून बोलण्याची गंमत' तुमच्या शब्दांत मांडा.
questions.answer: सुधीरच्या घरात सर्वजण यमक जुळवून बोलत होते. साध्या संवादातही कवितेची लय आल्यामुळे घरातील वातावरण आनंदी झाले होते. शब्दांच्या खेळामुळे संवादात जी रंजकता आली, तीच खरी कवितेतून बोलण्याची गंमत होती.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: या पाठातील आशयाच्या आधारे तुमच्या शब्दांत एक छानशी कथा तयार करून लिहा.
questions.answer: सुधीरला शाळेत एक प्रकल्प मिळतो. तो घरी आल्यावर कुटुंबातील सदस्यांच्या मदतीने कवितेत संवाद साधायला शिकतो. सुरुवातीला त्याला कठीण जाते, पण हळूहळू तो शब्दांशी खेळायला लागतो आणि त्याचा प्रकल्प यशस्वी होतो.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: पाठातील कोणता काव्यसंवाद तुम्हांला सर्वाधिक आवडला, ते सकारण सांगा.
questions.answer: मला आजी आणि आजोबांमधील संवाद आवडला, कारण त्यात त्यांनी जुन्या म्हणींचा वापर करून यमक अतिशय खुबीने जुळवले होते.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: पाठात आलेल्या साहित्यिकांची नावे लिहा.
questions.answer: शांता शेळके, ग. दि. माडगूळकर, बालकवी, कुसुमाग्रज.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: हेका धरणे
questions.answer: हट्ट करणे

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: भावनांचे मोहोळ चेतवणे
questions.answer: भावना जागृत करणे

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: दिलेल्या चित्रातील रिकाम्या चौकटीत वाक्यांशी संबंधित म्हण ओळखा व लिहा.
questions.text: दिलेल्या चित्रात दर्शवल्याप्रमाणे 'फुशारकी मारणाऱ्याचा पराजय होतो' या अर्थाची म्हण कोणती?
questions.answer: गर्वाचे घर खाली

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: दिलेल्या वाक्यांशी संबंधित म्हण ओळखा व लिहा.
questions.text: न आवडणाऱ्या माणसाने कितीही चांगली गोष्ट केली, तरी ती पसंत पडत नाही.
questions.answer: नावडतीचे मीठ अळणी

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: खालील वाक्यातील ठळक शब्दांचे अर्थ समजून घेऊन लिहा.
questions.text: सकाळचा चहा मला कपात काठोकाठ भरलेला लागतो. त्यात कपात केलेली मला चालत नाही. (येथे 'कपात' या शब्दाचे दोन अर्थ सांगा.)
questions.answer: १. कपात - चहा पिण्याचे भांडे (कपामध्ये). २. कपात - घट किंवा कमी करणे.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: तुम्ही यावर्षी पूर्ण केलेला प्रकल्प कोणता व तो कसा पूर्ण केला, त्या सर्व कृती क्रमवार लिहून त्यांचा ओघतक्ता बनवा.
questions.answer: विद्यार्थ्यांनी स्वतःच्या प्रकल्पाची माहिती (उदा. विषय निवडणे -> माहिती मिळवणे -> चित्रे गोळा करणे -> लेखन करणे -> सादरीकरण) क्रमाने लिहावी.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: 'अ' गट आणि 'ब' गट यांच्या योग्य जोड्या जुळवा.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: खालील ओळींचा तुम्हांला समजलेला अर्थ लिहा.
questions.text:
करून जावे असेही काही, दुनियातून या जाताना
गहिवर यावा जगास साऱ्या, निरोप घेताना
questions.answer: या ओळींचा अर्थ असा आहे की, या जगातून निरोप घेताना म्हणजेच मृत्यूसमयी आपण असे काहीतरी थोर किंवा परोपकारी कार्य करून जावे की, संपूर्ण जगाला आपल्या जाण्याने मनापासून दुःख व्हावे आणि सर्वांचे डोळे पाणावावेत.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: संकटात कसे वागावे हे कवितेच्या आधारे तुमच्या शब्दांत लिहा.
questions.answer: संकट आले असता त्याला न घाबरता धैर्याने सामोरे जावे. संकटाच्या डोळ्यांत डोळे घालून त्याला प्रति आव्हान द्यावे. संकटातही आपले हास्य आणि माणुसकी हरवू देऊ नये.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: 'संकटांना न घाबरता तोंड द्यावे', याविषयी तुमच्या वाचनात आलेल्या एखाद्या प्रसंगाचे वर्णन करा.
questions.answer: मी वाचलेल्या एका कथेत, एका छोट्या मुलाने रेल्वेचे रूळ तुटलेले पाहिले. गाडी येणार हे लक्षात येताच त्याने न घाबरता आपले लाल शर्ट झेंड्यासारखे हलवून गाडी थांबवली. त्याने स्वतःच्या जिवाची पर्वा न करता शेकडो प्रवाशांचे प्राण वाचवले. हा प्रसंग संकटात न डगमगता धैर्याने वागण्याचे उत्तम उदाहरण आहे.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: कवीने या कवितेतून दिलेला संदेश तुमच्या शब्दांत लिहा.
questions.answer: कवीने या कवितेतून स्वाभिमानाने, धैर्याने आणि जिद्दीने जगण्याचा संदेश दिला आहे. आपली स्वप्ने आभाळाएवढी मोठी असली तरी आपले पाय जमिनीवर असावेत. संकटांना न घाबरता त्यांना सामोरे जावे आणि जगातून जाताना आपल्या कर्तृत्वाने सर्वांच्या मनात जागा निर्माण करावी, असा मोलाचा संदेश या कवितेतून मिळतो.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: कोळीणीच्या घराची वैशिष्ट्ये सांगा.
questions.answer: १. जमिनीखाली एक फूट खोल तिरपे बीळ. २. बिळाच्या तोंडावर रेशमी धाग्यांचे घट्ट विणलेले झाकण. ३. आतून मऊ रेशमी अस्तर. ४. बाहेरून माती व पालापाचोळा लावून लपवलेले दार.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: लेखक डोंगरावरच्या जमिनीचे निरीक्षण करू लागले.
questions.answer: लेखकांना कोळीणीचे जमिनीखालचे घर शोधायचे होते, जे जमिनीशी इतके एकरूप झाले होते की ते सहज दिसत नव्हते.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: लेखकांना बाहेरच्या जगाचा विसर पडला.
questions.answer: कोळीणीच्या हालचाली आणि तिचे आपल्या घराचे संरक्षण करण्याचे कौशल्य पाहण्यात लेखक पूर्णपणे मग्न झाले होते.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: लेखकांनी कोळीणीच्या घराच्या दारापाशी असलेले अडथळे दूर सारले.
questions.answer: लेखकांना कोळीणीच्या घराच्या दाराची हालचाल स्पष्टपणे पाहायची होती आणि तिचे छायाचित्र घ्यायचे होते.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: कोळीण बिळाचे संरक्षण सोडून जात नाही.
questions.answer: कोळीणीला आपल्या घराचे आणि आतील अंडी किंवा पिलांचे शत्रूपासून संरक्षण करायचे असते, म्हणून ती दार घट्ट धरून ठेवते.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: लेखकांनी गवताच्या पात्याचे टोक कोळीणीच्या दाराला लावले.
questions.answer: कोळीणीला वाटले की बाहेर सावज आले आहे, म्हणून तिने दार किंचित उघडून गवताचे पाते ओढण्याचा प्रयत्न केला.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: पावसाचा कुठेतरी शिडकावा झाला.
questions.answer: पावसामुळे जमिनीतील कीटक बाहेर पडले आणि कोळीणीला तिचे भक्ष्य मिळण्याची संधी निर्माण झाली.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: कोळीणीने माघारी दार बंद केले.
questions.answer: लेखकांनी लावलेले गवताचे पाते हे भक्ष्य नसून काहीतरी वेगळे आहे हे समजताच कोळीणीने सावध होऊन दार जोरात ओढून बंद केले.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: कोळीणीला सोबत्यांच्या पावलांचा आवाज आला.
questions.answer: पावलांच्या कंपनांमुळे कोळीण सावध झाली आणि तिने आपल्या घराचे दार आतून घट्ट ओढून धरले.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: आकृतीत दिलेल्या मुद्द्यांच्या आधारे उत्तर लिहा.
questions.text: कोळीणीच्या घराची रचना आणि तिची शिकार करण्याची पद्धत स्पष्ट करा.
questions.answer: कोळीण जमिनीखाली एक फूट खोल बीळ बनवते, ज्याला रेशमी अस्तर असते. दारावर मातीचे झाकण असते जे ओळखू येत नाही. शिकार करण्यासाठी ती दाराला किंचित उघडे ठेवून कंपनांची वाट पाहते. भक्ष्य जवळ येताच ती झडप घालून त्याला आत ओढते.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: तुम्हांला पक्ष्यांच्या, प्राण्यांच्या घरांची नावे माहीत आहेत. ती खालील चौकटीत लिहा.
questions.text: पुढील प्राण्यांच्या घरांना काय म्हणतात? (१) सुगरण (२) वाघ (३) घोडा (४) पक्षी
questions.answer: १. सुगरण - खोपा, २. वाघ - गुहा, ३. घोडा - तबेला/पागा, ४. पक्षी - घरटे.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: प्रतीक्षा करणे
questions.answer: वाट पाहणे.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: पारखा होणे
questions.answer: मुकणे किंवा वंचित होणे.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: पसार होणे
questions.answer: पळून जाणे.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: कवयित्रीने असे का म्हटले असावे ते तुमच्या शब्दांत लिहा.
questions.text: या मोत्यांचा (पाण्याचा) संचय कर.
questions.answer: पाणी हे जीवन आहे. पाण्याशिवाय सजीव सृष्टी जगू शकत नाही. भविष्यातील पाण्याची टंचाई टाळण्यासाठी पावसाच्या पाण्याचा साठा करणे आवश्यक आहे, म्हणून कवयित्रीने असे म्हटले आहे.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: कवयित्रीने असे का म्हटले असावे ते तुमच्या शब्दांत लिहा.
questions.text: निसर्गाला जे कळते ते माणसाला कळत नाही.
questions.answer: निसर्ग चक्राकार पद्धतीने पाणी देऊन सृष्टीचे रक्षण करतो, पण माणूस पैशाच्या मोहात पडून पाण्याचे महत्त्व विसरला आहे. निसर्गाचे हे साधे गणित माणसाला समजत नाही, म्हणून कवयित्रीने असे म्हटले आहे.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: खाली दिलेल्या अर्थाच्या ओळी कवितेतून शोधून लिहा.
questions.text: आकाशातून पडणाऱ्या पावसाच्या थेंबाने धान्य पिकते.
questions.answer: मोती बनुनी येते खाली, मातीमध्ये मिसळे, त्यातून मग पिकते धान्य, हिरेमाणके लखलखले.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: खाली दिलेल्या अर्थाच्या ओळी कवितेतून शोधून लिहा.
questions.text: मनुष्य खणखणत वाजणाऱ्या नाण्यांचा तिजोरीत संग्रह करतो.
questions.answer: खणखणती त्या नाण्यांच्या, तिजोरीमध्ये संग्रह करतो.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: खाली दिलेल्या अर्थाच्या ओळी कवितेतून शोधून लिहा.
questions.text: निसर्गाचे मोल न जाणणे हे स्वत:ला फसवण्यासारखे आहे.
questions.answer: निसर्गाचे हे मोल न जाणे, ही तर तुझीच फसवणूक.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: आभाळातील मोती.
questions.answer: आभाळातील मोती म्हणजे पावसाचे थेंब. पावसाचे थेंब आकाशातून खाली पडताना मोत्यांसारखे चमकतात.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: मातीतील मोती.
questions.answer: मातीतील मोती म्हणजे शेतात पिकणारे धान्य. पावसाच्या पाण्यामुळे मातीतून जे पीक येते, त्याला कवयित्रीने मातीतील मोती म्हटले आहे.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: मोत्यांचा संचय.
questions.answer: मोत्यांचा संचय म्हणजे पावसाच्या पाण्याचे संवर्धन किंवा साठवणूक करणे.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: बहुमोल थेंब.
questions.answer: पाण्याचा प्रत्येक थेंब हा सोन्या-नाण्यापेक्षाही मौल्यवान आहे, कारण तो जीव वाचवतो.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: तहानेसाठी सांग पुरे का घोट तुला रे सोन्याचा? आभाळातील बहुमोलाचा, थेंब आज हा पाण्याचा ।।
questions.answer: जेव्हा माणसाला खूप तहान लागते, तेव्हा त्याची तहान सोन्याचा घोट घेतल्याने भागणार नाही. तहान भागवण्यासाठी पाण्याचा थेंबच लागतो. म्हणजेच संपत्तीपेक्षा पाण्याचे महत्त्व अधिक आहे, हा विचार येथे मांडला आहे.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: दिलेल्या आकृतीचे निरीक्षण करा आणि फरक स्पष्ट करून तक्ता पूर्ण करा.
questions.text: माणसाचे धन आणि निसर्गाचे धन यांतील फरक स्पष्ट करा.
questions.answer:
माणसाचे धन: १) कोणते? - नाणी/पैसा, २) कोठे ठेवतात? - तिजोरीत, ३) उपयोग - भौतिक सुखासाठी. 
निसर्गाचे धन: १) कोणते? - पाणी/पावसाचे थेंब, २) कोठे ठेवतात? - मातीत/धरणे/निसर्ग, ३) उपयोग - सजीवांच्या जीवनासाठी.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: खालील शब्दाचा अर्थ समजून घेऊन वाक्यात उपयोग करा.
questions.text: बहुमोल
questions.answer: वाक्य: पाण्याचा प्रत्येक थेंब बहुमोल आहे, तो वाया घालवू नका.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: माती-मोती अशा शब्दांच्या अर्थात केवळ एका मात्रेमुळे खूप फरक होतो. अशा शब्दांच्या जोड्या शोधा व लिहा.
questions.text: एका मात्रेमुळे अर्थ बदलणाऱ्या शब्दांच्या जोड्या लिहा.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नाचे उत्तर एका वाक्यात लिहा.
questions.text: जलप्रदूषण म्हणजे काय?
questions.answer: नैसर्गिक पाण्यात टाकाऊ किंवा विषारी पदार्थ मिसळल्यामुळे पाणी अशुद्ध व वापरण्यास अयोग्य होणे म्हणजे जलप्रदूषण होय.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: तुमच्या मते जलसंवर्धनासाठी कोणते उपाय करावेत?
questions.text: जलसंवर्धनासाठी तुम्ही कोणते उपाय सुचवाल?
questions.answer: १) नळ चालू ठेवू नये, पाण्याचा अपव्यय टाळावा. २) पावसाचे पाणी जमिनीत जिरवावे (Rainwater Harvesting). ३) पाण्याचे पुनर्भरण करावे.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: माणसाने निसर्गाकडे बघण्याचा दृष्टिकोन बदलायला हवा. या वाक्याचा तुम्हांला समजलेला अर्थ स्पष्ट करा.
questions.text: निसर्गाकडे बघण्याचा दृष्टिकोन बदलणे म्हणजे काय?
questions.answer: माणूस निसर्गाकडे केवळ स्वतःच्या गरजा पूर्ण करण्याचे साधन म्हणून पाहतो. पण निसर्ग हा आपला आधार आहे. आपण निसर्गाचे मालक नसून त्याचे रक्षक आहोत, हा भाव ठेवून पाण्याचा व इतर साधनांचा जपून वापर करणे म्हणजे दृष्टिकोन बदलणे होय.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नाचे उत्तर तुमच्या शब्दांत लिहा.
questions.text: श्रुतींच्या नाराजीबाबत तुमचे मत लिहा.
questions.answer: श्रुतीला जेवणात तिच्या आवडीच्या भाज्या नसल्या की ती नाराज व्हायची. तिची ही नाराजी अयोग्य होती, कारण अन्नाचा मान राखणे व सर्व प्रकारच्या भाज्या खाणे आरोग्यासाठी आवश्यक असते. अन्नाची नासाडी करणे चुकीचे आहे.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नाचे उत्तर एका वाक्यात लिहा.
questions.text: आई श्रुतीवर का रागावली?
questions.answer: श्रुतीने ताटात कारल्याची भाजी टाकून दिली आणि ती जेवणावरून तशीच उठून गेली, म्हणून आई तिच्यावर रागावली.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: श्रुतीला नवीन वर्षाचा कोणता संकल्प सुचला?
questions.answer: 'मी यापुढे कधीही अन्नाचा वाया घालवणार नाही आणि ताटात काहीही टाकणार नाही', हा संकल्प श्रुतीला सुचला.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: खालील ओळींचा तुम्हांला समजलेला अर्थ लिहा.
questions.text: मुखी घास घेता करावा विचार। कशासाठी हे अन्न मी सेवणार ।।
questions.answer: या ओळींचा अर्थ असा की, जेवताना प्रत्येक घासागणिक आपण विचार केला पाहिजे की हे अन्न आपल्याला जगण्यासाठी आणि कार्य करण्यासाठी शक्ती देते. त्यामुळे अन्नाचा आदर करावा आणि ते वाया घालवू नये.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: दिलेल्या चित्रातील तक्त्यानुसार, खालील कृती योग्य की अयोग्य ते ठरवा.
questions.text: वैभवी शाळेत जेवताना घरी डबा विसरली. त्या वेळी अनुजाने स्वतःच्या डब्यातील पोळीभाजी तिला दिली.
questions.answer: योग्य

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: खालील कृती योग्य की अयोग्य आहेत ते ठरवा.
questions.text: राजेंद्र सतत बाहेरचे जंकफूड खातो.
questions.answer: अयोग्य

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: खालील कृती योग्य की अयोग्य आहेत ते ठरवा.
questions.text: यास्मिन टीव्ही बघत जेवण करते.
questions.answer: अयोग्य

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: खालील कृती योग्य की अयोग्य आहेत ते ठरवा.
questions.text: आनंद जेवण करण्यापूर्वी हात स्वच्छ धुतो.
questions.answer: योग्य

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: खालील कृती योग्य की अयोग्य आहेत ते ठरवा.
questions.text: पीटर जेवताना खूपच बडबड करतो.
questions.answer: अयोग्य

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: खालील कृती योग्य की अयोग्य आहेत ते ठरवा.
questions.text: रुपाली सर्व प्रकारच्या भाज्या खाते.
questions.answer: योग्य

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: राजुचे गुणविशेष:
questions.answer: जिज्ञासू, चौकस, दगडधोंडे गोळा करण्याचा छंद असलेला.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: राजुला सापडलेल्या धोंड्याची वैशिष्ट्ये:
questions.answer: गुळगुळीत, चकाकणारा, प्रकाश उत्सर्जित करणारा, सजीव आणि दगड खाणारा.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: शास्त्रज्ञ डॉ. पंडितांनी धोंड्याबद्दल सांगितलेली माहिती:
questions.answer: तो दगड नसून परग्रहावरील एक सजीव प्राणी आहे, तो स्वतःचे अस्तित्व टिकवण्यासाठी दगड खातो.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: राजुला नवीन धोंड्याची गंमत वाटली.
questions.answer: जेव्हा राजुने धोंड्याला स्पर्श केला आणि त्यातून मंद प्रकाश बाहेर पडला, तेव्हा त्याला गंमत वाटली.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: प्रखर प्रकाशातही राजुचे आईबाबा झोपले होते.
questions.answer: जेव्हा धोंड्याने उत्सर्जित केलेल्या निळ्या प्रकाशलहरींमुळे आईबाबांना गाढ झोप लागली होती.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: राजुच्या मेंदूवर झोपेचा अंमल चढू लागला.
questions.answer: जेव्हा धोंड्यातून विशिष्ट प्रकारच्या लहरी बाहेर पडल्या, तेव्हा राजुच्या मेंदूवर झोपेचा अंमल चढू लागला.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: चकाकणारा दगड सापडल्यानंतर राजुची झालेली मनःस्थिती, याबाबतचे वर्णन तुमच्या शब्दांत लिहा.
questions.answer: राजुला तो दगड पाहून खूप आश्चर्य वाटले. त्याच्या मनात कुतूहल निर्माण झाले. तो दगड घरी आणताना त्याच्या मनात भीती आणि आनंद अशा संमिश्र भावना होत्या.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: राजुला दगड सापडण्यापासून त्याला शास्त्रज्ञ भेटेपपर्यंत घडलेल्या गोष्टी क्रमाने लिहा.
questions.answer: १. राजुला ओढ्यात चकाकणारा धोंडा सापडला. २. त्याने तो धोंडा घरी आणून कपाटात ठेवला. ३. रात्री धोंड्यातून प्रकाश बाहेर पडताना दिसला. ४. धोंड्याचा आकार वाढलेला दिसला. ५. राजुने तो धोंडा डॉ. पंडितांकडे नेला.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: चौकसपणा व जिज्ञासावृत्ती हे गुण तुम्हांला महत्त्वाचे वाटतात का? का ते सांगा.
questions.answer: हो, हे गुण महत्त्वाचे आहेत. कारण जिज्ञासावृत्तीमुळेच आपण नवीन गोष्टी शिकतो आणि चौकसपणामुळे विज्ञानातील नवीन शोध लागण्यास मदत होते.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: कंसातील शब्द योग्य ठिकाणी वापरून रिकाम्या जागा पूर्ण करा. (कडा, विचारशृंखला, अस्वस्थता, घालमेल)
questions.text: लेखकाची ______ तुटल्यामुळे त्यांना खूप राग आला.
questions.answer: विचारशृंखला

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: कंसातील शब्द योग्य ठिकाणी वापरून रिकाम्या जागा पूर्ण करा. (कडा, विचारशृंखला, अस्वस्थता, घालमेल)
questions.text: शिक्षकांचा ______ कटाक्ष बघून विद्यार्थी एकदम शांत बसले.
questions.answer: कडक (कडा)

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: कंसातील शब्द योग्य ठिकाणी वापरून रिकाम्या जागा पूर्ण करा. (कडा, विचारशृंखला, अस्वस्थता, घालमेल)
questions.text: वार्षिक परीक्षेचा निकाल जाहीर होताना संजयच्या मनात प्रचंड ______ होत होती.
questions.answer: घालमेल

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: कंसातील शब्द योग्य ठिकाणी वापरून रिकाम्या जागा पूर्ण करा. (कडा, विचारशृंखला, अस्वस्थता, घालमेल)
questions.text: रामरावांची ______ बघून त्यांना ताबडतोब दवाखान्यात भरती केले गेले.
questions.answer: अस्वस्थता

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: खालील दिलेल्या अक्षरांच्या चौकटीतून लपलेली म्हण ओळखा व लिहा.
questions.text: (अ) का हा प्रा ति मा श चा बे त्या ल रि ए क म भा ड चि ना घ्या र ए ना म ज का रा चे वे वे घे.
questions.answer: अति शहाणा त्याचा बैल रिकामा / काखेत कळसा गावाला वळसा.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: राजुला ज्याप्रमाणे अनोखा धोंडा सापडला, त्याप्रमाणे तुम्हांला कधी वेगळीच वस्तू सापडली का? त्या कोणत्या?
questions.answer: विद्यार्थ्यांनी स्वतःचा अनुभव लिहावा. उदा. एकदा मला समुद्राकाठी एक विचित्र आकाराचा आणि शंखासारखा आवाज करणारा दगड सापडला होता.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: या पाठाचा शेवट बदलून वेगळ्या प्रकारे कथा पूर्ण करण्याचा तुम्ही प्रयत्न करा.
questions.answer: विद्यार्थ्यांनी कल्पनेने शेवट बदलावा. उदा. तो धोंडा प्रत्यक्षात एक संदेशवाहक यंत्र निघाले आणि त्याने राजुला परग्रहाची सफर घडवून आणली.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: दोन शास्त्रज्ञ व राजु यांच्यात काय बोलणे झाले असेल, ते संवादाचे रूपाने लिहा.
questions.answer: राजु: सर, हा दगड प्रकाश का देतो? शास्त्रज्ञ: राजु, हा साधा दगड नाही, हा परग्रहावरील जीव आहे. राजु: मग हा काय खातो? शास्त्रज्ञ: हा दगड खाऊन ऊर्जा मिळवतो.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: महर्षी धोंडो केशव कर्वे हे ______ म्हणून ओळखले जात.
questions.answer: अण्णासाहेब कर्वे

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: दिलेले विधान चूक की बरोबर ते लिहा.
questions.text: नामदार गोपाळ कृष्ण गोखले हे लोकमान्य टिळकांचे समकालीन नव्हते.
questions.answer: चूक

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: स्तंभ 'अ' आणि स्तंभ 'ब' यांच्या योग्य जोड्या लावा.
questions.answer: महर्षी कर्वे - भारतरत्न, गोपाळ कृष्ण गोखले - भारत सेवक समाज, एस. एन. डी. टी. - महिला विद्यापीठ, महात्मा गांधी - गोखले यांना गुरु मानणारे

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: महर्षी कर्वे यांच्या मते राष्ट्राचे भावी आधारस्तंभ कोण आहेत?
questions.answer: विद्यार्थी व विद्यार्थिनी

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: गोपाळ कृष्ण गोखले यांनी कोणती संस्था स्थापन केली?
questions.answer: गोपाळ कृष्ण गोखले यांनी 'सर्व्हंट्स ऑफ इंडिया सोसायटी' (भारत सेवक समाज) ही संस्था स्थापन केली.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: महर्षी कर्वे यांनी विद्यार्थ्यांना कोणत्या दोन गोष्टी ध्यानी बाळगायला सांगितल्या आहेत?
questions.answer: (१) गतानुगतिक वृत्ती टाकून स्वतंत्र विचार करायला शिकावे आणि (२) मनाचा समतोलपणा राखावा.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: मनाचा समतोल सांभाळणे का आवश्यक आहे?
questions.answer: कारण मनाचा तोल सांभाळला नाही, तर जगात मोठमोठे अनर्थ घडून येतात, म्हणून मनाचा समतोल सांभाळणे आवश्यक आहे.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: देशाच्या सर्वांगीण उन्नतीसाठी गोपाळ कृष्ण गोखले यांनी कोणते विचार मांडले आहेत?
questions.answer: देशाच्या उन्नतीसाठी ऐक्य आणि देशभक्तीची गरज आहे. त्याग करण्याची तयारी हवी, केवळ बोलणे नको तर काम हवे. आपण सारे हिंदी आहोत हा भाव हवा आणि शिस्त, स्वार्थत्याग व दृढता हे गुण अंगी बाळगायला हवेत.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: दिलेल्या चित्राचे निरीक्षण करून प्रश्नाचे उत्तर लिहा.
questions.text: दिलेल्या चित्रातील थोर समाजसुधारकाचे नाव काय आहे?
questions.answer: महर्षी धोंडो केशव कर्वे (अण्णासाहेब कर्वे)

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: दिलेल्या चित्रातील व्यक्तीने स्त्रियांच्या शिक्षणासाठी कोणत्या संस्थेची स्थापना केली?
questions.answer: चित्रातील व्यक्तीने (महर्षी कर्वे) स्त्रियांच्या शिक्षणासाठी 'एस. एन. डी. टी. महिला विद्यापीठ' या संस्थेची स्थापना केली.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: 'गतानुगतिक वृत्ती' म्हणजे काय?
questions.answer: गतानुगतिक वृत्ती म्हणजे जुन्या, ठराविक विचारांचे किंवा परंपरेचे अंधानुकरण करण्याची वृत्ती.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: "बोलणे नको, काम हवे!" या विधानाचा तुम्हाला समजलेला अर्थ लिहा.
questions.answer: केवळ मोठ्या गप्पा मारून किंवा भाषणे देऊन देशाची प्रगती होत नाही, तर प्रत्यक्ष कृती आणि कष्ट करण्याची गरज असते, असा या विधानाचा अर्थ आहे.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: आपल्या सर्व कामांत शिस्त, ______ व दृढता हे गुण प्रामुख्याने हवेत.
questions.answer: स्वार्थत्याग

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: १. पंढरी नगरी दैवत ______.
questions.answer: श्रीहरी

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.answer: गोपाळकाळा

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: खालील विधाने चूक की बरोबर ते लिहा.
questions.text: संत कान्होपात्रा यांच्या मते पांडुरंग हे त्यांचे आईवडील आहेत.
questions.answer: बरोबर

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.instruction: खालील विधाने चूक की बरोबर ते लिहा.
questions.text: भीमा नदीच्या तीरावर खूप दुःख आहे.
questions.answer: चूक (भीमातीरी सुख आहे)

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: अ गट आणि ब गट यांच्या योग्य जोड्या लावा.
questions.answer: आषाढी-कार्तिकी - महापूजा, भीमा तीर - सुख, विटेवर - पांडुरंग, भजनाचा - गजर

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: पंढरीची वारी नित्यनेमाने करणाऱ्यांना काय म्हणतात?
questions.answer: वारकरी

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: संत नरहरी सोनार यांच्या हृदयात कोण बिंबले आहे?
questions.answer: संत नरहरी सोनार यांच्या हृदयात श्रीहरी (पांडुरंग) बिंबले आहेत.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: संत कान्होपात्रा कोणाचे दर्शन घेऊन तृप्त झाल्या?
questions.answer: विटेवर उभ्या असलेल्या पांडुरंगाचे दर्शन घेऊन संत कान्होपात्रा तृप्त झाल्या.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: पंढरपुरात आषाढी-कार्तिकीला कोणते दृश्य दिसते?
questions.answer: आषाढी-कार्तिकीला पंढरपुरात थोर महापूजा होते, भजनाचा गजर होतो आणि साधुसंत हातात पताका घेऊन नामाचा उच्चार करतात.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: पांडुरंगाच्या दर्शनाने संत कान्होपात्रा यांच्या मनात कोणते बदल होतात?
questions.answer: पांडुरंगाच्या दर्शनाने संत कान्होपात्रा यांच्या मनातील ताप (त्रास), चिंता, तळमळ आणि अंतरीची व्यथा दूर होते.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: संत कान्होपात्रा पंढरपूरला आपले 'माहेर' का म्हणतात?
questions.answer: कारण पंढरपुरात भीमा नदीच्या तीरावर सुख व आनंद आहे आणि तिथे राहणारे पांडुरंग हेच त्यांचे आईवडील आहेत, म्हणून त्या पंढरपूरला माहेर म्हणतात.

questions.subject: Marathi
questions.text: संत नरहरी सोनार यांनी अभंगात वारकऱ्यांचे व पंढरीचे वर्णन कसे केले आहे ते तुमच्या शब्दांत लिहा.
questions.answer: संत नरहरी सोनार म्हणतात की पंढरी नगरीचे दैवत श्रीहरी आहे आणि वारकरी तिथे नित्यनेमाने वंदना करण्यासाठी जातात. आषाढी-कार्तिकीला तिथे भजनाचा मोठा गजर होतो. अनेक साधुसंत पताका घेऊन नामाचा जयघोष करतात. गोपाळकाल्याच्या आनंदाने भक्तांच्या हृदयात ईश्वराचे रूप ठसते.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.instruction: Answer the following question based on triangle properties.
questions.text: Draw an obtuse-angled triangle and a right-angled triangle. Find the points of concurrence of the angle bisectors of each triangle. Where do the points of concurrence lie?
questions.answer: The point of concurrence of the angle bisectors of a triangle is called the incenter. For both obtuse-angled and right-angled triangles, the incenter lies in the interior of the triangle.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.instruction: Answer the following question based on triangle properties.
questions.text: Draw a right-angled triangle. Draw the perpendicular bisectors of its sides. Where does the point of concurrence lie?
questions.answer: The point of concurrence of the perpendicular bisectors of the sides of a right-angled triangle (circumcenter) lies on the midpoint of the hypotenuse.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: Maithili, Shaila and Ajay live in three different places in the city. A toy shop is equidistant from the three houses. Which geometrical construction should be used to represent this? Explain your answer.
questions.answer: The construction of the circumcircle of a triangle should be used. The point of concurrence of the perpendicular bisectors of the sides (circumcenter) of the triangle formed by the three houses is equidistant from the vertices (houses).

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: If 7 kg onions cost 140 rupees, how much must we pay for 12 kg onions?
questions.answer: Cost of 1 kg onions = 140 / 7 = 20 rupees. Cost of 12 kg onions = 12 × 20 = 240 rupees.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: If 600 rupees buy 15 bunches of feed, how many will 1280 rupees buy?
questions.answer: Cost of 1 bunch = 600 / 15 = 40 rupees. Number of bunches for 1280 rupees = 1280 / 40 = 32 bunches.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: For 9 cows, 13 kg 500 g of food supplement are required every day. In the same proportion, how much will be needed for 12 cows?
questions.answer: Supplement per cow = 13.5 / 9 = 1.5 kg. For 12 cows = 12 × 1.5 = 18 kg.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: The cost of 12 quintals of soyabean is ₹36,000 rupees. How much will 8 quintals cost?
questions.answer: Cost of 1 quintal = 36000 / 12 = 3000 rupees. Cost of 8 quintals = 8 × 3000 = 24,000 rupees.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: Two mobiles cost 16,000 rupees. How much money will be required to buy 13 such mobiles?
questions.answer: Cost of 1 mobile = 16000 / 2 = 8000 rupees. Cost of 13 mobiles = 13 × 8000 = 1,04,000 rupees.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: Five workers take 12 days to weed a field. How many days would 6 workers take?
questions.answer: Total work = 5 × 12 = 60 man-days. Days for 6 workers = 60 / 6 = 10 days.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: Five workers take 12 days to weed a field. How many days would 15 workers take?
questions.answer: Total work = 5 × 12 = 60 man-days. Days for 15 workers = 60 / 15 = 4 days.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: Mohanrao took 10 days to finish a book, reading 40 pages every day. How many pages must he read in a day to finish it in 8 days?
questions.answer: Total pages = 10 × 40 = 400 pages. Pages per day for 8 days = 400 / 8 = 50 pages.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: Mary cycles at 6 km per hour. How long will she take to reach her Aunt's house which is 12 km away?
questions.answer: Time = Distance / Speed = 12 / 6 = 2 hours.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: Mary cycles at a speed of 4 km/hr to reach her Aunt's house which is 12 km away. How long would she take?
questions.answer: Time = Distance / Speed = 12 / 4 = 3 hours.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: The stock of grain in a government warehouse lasts 30 days for 4000 people. How many days will it last for 6000 people?
questions.answer: Total stock = 30 × 4000 = 1,20,000 units. Days for 6000 people = 1,20,000 / 6000 = 20 days.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: Suresh and Ramesh together invested 144000 rupees in the ratio 4:5 and bought a plot of land. After some years they sold it at a profit of 20%. What is the profit each of them got?
questions.answer: Total profit = 20% of 144000 = 28,800. Ratio = 4:5. Suresh's profit = (4/9) × 28800 = 12,800 rupees. Ramesh's profit = (5/9) × 28800 = 16,000 rupees.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: Virat and Samrat together invested 50000 and 120000 rupees to start a business. They suffered a loss of 20%. How much loss did each of them incur?
questions.answer: Total investment = 1,70,000. Total loss = 20% of 1,70,000 = 34,000. Ratio = 5:12. Virat's loss = (5/17) × 34000 = 10,000 rupees. Samrat's loss = (12/17) × 34000 = 24,000 rupees.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: Shweta, Piyush and Nachiket together invested 80000 rupees. Shweta's share was 30000 rupees and Piyush's 12000. At the end of the year they made a profit of 24%. What was Nachiket's investment and what was his share of the profit?
questions.answer: Nachiket's investment = 80000 - (30000 + 12000) = 38,000 rupees. Total profit = 24% of 80000 = 19,200. Nachiket's profit = (38000 / 80000) × 19200 = 9,120 rupees.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: A and B shared a profit of 24500 rupees in the proportion 3:7. Each of them gave 2% of his share of the profit to the Soldiers' Welfare Fund. What was the actual amount given to the Fund by each of them?
questions.answer: A's profit = (3/10) × 24500 = 7,350. A's donation = 2% of 7350 = 147 rupees. B's profit = (7/10) × 24500 = 17,150. B's donation = 2% of 17150 = 343 rupees.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: Jaya, Seema, Nikhil and Neelesh put in altogether 360000 rupees in the proportion 3:4:7:6. What was Jaya's actual share in the capital?
questions.answer: Total parts = 3+4+7+6 = 20. Jaya's share = (3/20) × 360000 = 54,000 rupees.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: Jaya, Seema, Nikhil and Neelesh invested in the proportion 3:4:7:6. They made a profit of 12%. How much profit did Nikhil make?
questions.answer: Total capital = 3,60,000. Total profit = 12% of 360000 = 43,200. Nikhil's profit share = (7/20) × 43200 = 15,120 rupees.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: If Rihanna deposits 1500 rupees in the school fund at 9 p.c.p.a for 2 years, what is the total amount she will get?
questions.answer: Interest = (P × R × T) / 100 = (1500 × 9 × 2) / 100 = 270 rupees. Total Amount = Principal + Interest = 1500 + 270 = 1770 rupees. Rihanna will get 1770 rupees.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: Jethalal took a housing loan of 2,50,000 rupees from a bank at 10 p.c.p.a. for 5 years. What is the yearly interest he must pay and the total amount he returns to the bank?
questions.answer: Total Interest = (250000 × 10 × 5) / 100 = 1,25,000 rupees. Yearly Interest = 1,25,000 / 5 = 25,000 rupees. Total Amount = 2,50,000 + 1,25,000 = 3,75,000 rupees.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: Shrikant deposited 85000 rupees for 2 1/2 years at 7 p.c.p.a. in a savings bank account. What is the total interest he received at the end of the period?
questions.answer: Interest = (P × R × T) / 100 = (85000 × 7 × 2.5) / 100 = 14,875 rupees. Shrikant received a total interest of 14,875 rupees.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: At a certain rate of interest, the interest after 4 years on 5000 rupees principal is 1200 rupees. What would be the interest on 15000 rupees at the same rate of interest for the same period?
questions.answer: Interest is directly proportional to the principal when rate and time are constant. Since 15000 is 3 times 5000, the interest will be 1200 × 3 = 3600 rupees.

questions.text: Radius (r) = 7 cm. Find Diameter (d) and Circumference (c).

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: Diameter (d) = 28 cm. Find Radius (r) and Circumference (c).
questions.answer: Radius (r) = d / 2 = 28 / 2 = 14 cm. Circumference (c) = π * d = (22/7) * 28 = 88 cm.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: Circumference (c) = 616 cm. Find Radius (r) and Diameter (d).
questions.answer: Circumference = π * d, so 616 = (22/7) * d. d = (616 * 7) / 22 = 196 cm. Radius (r) = 196 / 2 = 98 cm.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: Circumference (c) = 72.6 cm. Find Radius (r) and Diameter (d).

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: If the circumference of a circle is 176 cm, find its radius.
questions.answer: Circumference = 2 * π * r. 176 = 2 * (22/7) * r. r = (176 * 7) / 44 = 28 cm. The radius is 28 cm.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: The radius of a circular garden is 56 m. What would it cost to put a 4-round fence around this garden at a rate of 40 rupees per metre?
questions.answer: Circumference = 2 * π * r = 2 * (22/7) * 56 = 352 m. Length of 4-round fence = 352 * 4 = 1408 m. Total cost = 1408 * 40 = 56,320 rupees.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: The wheel of a bullock cart has a diameter of 1.4m. How many rotations will the wheel complete as the cart travels 1.1 km?
questions.answer: Distance in one rotation = Circumference = π * d = (22/7) * 1.4 = 4.4 m. Total distance = 1.1 km = 1100 m. Number of rotations = 1100 / 4.4 = 250 rotations.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: Write the names of the minor arcs, major arcs and semicircular arcs from among them.
questions.answer: Minor arcs are those with measures less than 180°. Major arcs are those with measures greater than 180°. Semicircular arcs are formed by a diameter and have a measure of 180°.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: In a circle with centre O, the measure of a minor arc is 110°. What is the measure of the major arc PYQ?
questions.answer: Measure of major arc = 360° - measure of corresponding minor arc. m(arc PYQ) = 360° - 110° = 250°.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: How is the area of a right-angled triangle related to the area of a rectangle formed by its sides?
questions.answer: The area of a right-angled triangle is half the area of the rectangle formed by the sides that make the right angle. Area = 1/2 × product of sides forming the right angle.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: If the side of a square is tripled, how many times will its area be as compared to the area of the original square?
questions.answer: The area will be 9 times the original area (since 3 squared is 9).

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: Why do we multiply by 2 in the formula for the total surface area of a cuboid: 2(lb + bh + lh)?
questions.answer: A cuboid has six faces where opposite faces have the same area. Therefore, we calculate the area of three distinct faces (lb, bh, lh) and multiply the sum by 2.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: A matchbox is 4 cm long, 2.5 cm broad and 1.5 cm in height. How much craft paper is required to cover its outer sides exactly?
questions.answer: Surface area = 2(lb + bh + lh) = 2(4 × 2.5 + 2.5 × 1.5 + 4 × 1.5) = 2(10 + 3.75 + 6) = 2(19.75) = 39.5 sqcm. 39.5 sqcm of paper is required.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: Define Perimeter.
questions.answer: The sum of the lengths of all sides of a closed figure is the perimeter of that figure.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: One side of a cubic box is 0.4 m. How much will it cost to paint the outer surface of the box at the rate of 50 rupees per sqm?
questions.answer: Surface area = 6 × (0.4)² = 0.96 sqm. Cost = 0.96 × 50 = 48 rupees.

questions.text: In the right-angled triangle, the base is 7 and the height is 24. Find the hypotenuse 'x'.
questions.answer: By Pythagoras' theorem, x² = 7² + 24² = 49 + 576 = 625. Therefore, x = 25.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: In the right-angled ΔPQR, ∠P = 90°. If l(PQ) = 24 cm and l(PR) = 10 cm, find the length of seg QR.
questions.answer: In ΔPQR, QR² = PQ² + PR² = 24² + 10² = 576 + 100 = 676. QR = √676 = 26 cm.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: In the right-angled ΔLMN, ∠M = 90°. If l(LM) = 12 cm and l(LN) = 20 cm, find the length of seg MN.
questions.answer: In ΔLMN, LN² = LM² + MN² => 20² = 12² + MN² => 400 = 144 + MN² => MN² = 256. MN = 16 cm.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: The top of a ladder of length 15 m reaches a window 9 m above the ground. What is the distance between the base of the wall and that of the ladder?
questions.answer: Let distance be x. Ladder² = height² + x² => 15² = 9² + x² => 225 = 81 + x² => x² = 144. x = 12 m.

questions.text: How is the fifth tally mark represented in a frequency table and why?

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: Why is a frequency table useful when we have a huge amount of data?
questions.answer: A frequency table is useful because it makes calculations easier. Instead of adding every individual score, we can multiply each score by its frequency and then add those products to find the total sum.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: List the four steps involved in making a frequency distribution table.
questions.answer: 1. Enter scores in ascending order in the first column. 2. Enter tally marks for each score in the second column. 3. Count tally marks and write the number in the frequency column. 4. Add all frequencies to find the total frequency N.

questions.text: Priya observed 50 peapods. The sum of all peas (scores) was 206. Calculate the average number of peas in a pod.

questions.answer: कोनमापकाच्या साहाय्याने १०५° चा कोन काढून, कंपासच्या साहाय्याने कोनाचे दोन समान भाग करणारा किरण (दुभाजक) काढावा.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: एक विशालकोन त्रिकोण काढा. त्या त्रिकोणातील कोनदुभाजकांचा संपात बिंदू काढा. हा संपात बिंदू त्रिकोणाच्या कोणत्या भागात आहे?
questions.answer: विशालकोन त्रिकोणाच्या तिन्ही कोनांचे दुभाजक एकाच बिंदूत छेदतात (एकसंपाती असतात). हा संपात बिंदू (अंतर्मध्य) त्रिकोणाच्या अंतर्भागात असतो.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.text: एक काटकोन त्रिकोण काढा. त्याच्या भुजांचे लंबदुभाजक काढा. त्यांचा संपात बिंदू कोठे आहे?
questions.answer: काटकोन त्रिकोणाच्या भुजांच्या लंबदुभाजकांचा संपात बिंदू (परिमध्य) हा कर्णाच्या मध्यबिंदूवर असतो.

questions.text: भैमिती, शैला व अजय हे तिघे एका शहरात वेगवेगळ्या ठिकाणी राहत असून त्यांच्या घरांपासून समान अंतरावर खेळण्याचे एक दुकान आहे. हे आकृतीच्या साहाय्याने दर्शवण्यासाठी कोणती भौमितिक रचना वापराल?
questions.answer: तिघांच्या घरांची स्थाने जोडल्यास एक त्रिकोण तयार होईल. या त्रिकोणाच्या भुजांचे लंबदुभाजक काढल्यास त्यांचा संपात बिंदू (परिमध्य) मिळेल, जो तिन्ही शिरोबिंदूंपासून (घरांपासून) समान अंतरावर असेल. म्हणून 'भुजांचे लंबदुभाजक' ही रचना वापरावी.

questions.text: राजेशचे वय सावित्रीच्या वयापेक्षा 5 वर्षांनी कमी आहे. त्यांच्या वयांची बेरीज 27 वर्षे आहे, तर प्रत्येकाचे वय किती ?
questions.answer: समजा सावित्रीचे वय x वर्षे आहे. राजेशचे वय (x-5) वर्षे. x + x - 5 = 27 => 2x = 32 => x = 16. सावित्रीचे वय 16 वर्षे व राजेशचे वय 11 वर्षे आहे.

questions.text: विराटने केलेल्या धावा रोहितच्या धावांच्या दुप्पट होत्या. दोघांच्या मिळून झालेल्या धावा द्विशतकापेक्षा दोनने कमी होत्या तर दोघांनी प्रत्येकी किती धावा काढल्या ?
questions.answer: रोहितच्या धावा x मानू. विराटच्या धावा 2x. x + 2x = 200 - 2 => 3x = 198 => x = 66. रोहितने 66 व विराटने 132 धावा काढल्या.

questions.answer: एकूण कामाचे दिवस = 5 × 12 = 60. म्हणून, 6 मजुरांना लागणारे दिवस = 60 / 6 = 10 दिवस.

questions.text: मोहनरावांनी रोज 40 पाने याप्रमाणे एक पुस्तक वाचले, तर ते पुस्तक 10 दिवसांत वाचून पूर्ण होते. तेच पुस्तक 8 दिवसांत वाचून पूर्ण करायचे असल्यास दररोज किती पाने वाचावीत ?
questions.answer: पुस्तकाची एकूण पाने = 40 × 10 = 400. 8 दिवसात पूर्ण करण्यासाठी रोजची पाने = 400 / 8 = 50 पाने.

questions.text: काटकोन त्रिकोण MPE मध्ये ∠P = 90° जर l(PQ) = 24 सेमी आणि l(PR) = 10 सेमी, तर रेख QR ची लांबी काढा.
questions.answer: पायथागोरसच्या सिद्धांतानुसार, QR² = PQ² + PR² = 24² + 10² = 576 + 100 = 676. म्हणून, QR = 26 सेमी.

questions.text: काटकोन ΔLMN मध्ये ∠M = 90° जर l(LM) = 12 सेमी आणि l(LN) = 20 सेमी, तर रेख MN ची लांबी काढा.
questions.answer: पायथागोरसच्या सिद्धांतानुसार, LN² = LM² + MN² => 20² = 12² + MN² => 400 = 144 + MN² => MN² = 256. म्हणून, MN = 16 सेमी.

questions.subject: Science
questions.chapter: The Living World : Adaptations and Classification
questions.instruction: Read the paragraph and answer the following questions. I am a penguin. I live in polar region covered by snow. My abdomen is white. My skin is thick and a layer of fat underneath. My body is spindle-shaped. My wings are small. My toes are webbed. We live in flocks.
questions.text: (a) Why is my skin white and thick and why is there a thick layer of fat underneath?
questions.answer: The white skin helps in camouflage against the snow. The thick skin and the layer of fat underneath act as insulation to protect the penguin from the extreme cold of the polar region.

questions.subject: Science
questions.chapter: The Living World : Adaptations and Classification
questions.instruction: Read the paragraph and answer the following questions. I am a penguin. I live in polar region covered by snow. My abdomen is white. My skin is thick and a layer of fat underneath. My body is spindle-shaped. My wings are small. My toes are webbed. We live in flocks.
questions.text: (b) Why do we live in flocks sticking close to each other?
questions.answer: Penguins live in flocks and stick close to each other to share body heat and keep warm, and also to protect themselves from predators.

questions.subject: Science
questions.chapter: The Living World : Adaptations and Classification
questions.instruction: Read the paragraph and answer the following questions. I am a penguin. I live in polar region covered by snow. My abdomen is white. My skin is thick and a layer of fat underneath. My body is spindle-shaped. My wings are small. My toes are webbed. We live in flocks.
questions.text: (c) Which geographical region do I inhabit? Why?
questions.answer: Penguins inhabit the Polar region (specifically Antarctica). They live there because their bodies are adapted to extreme cold with thick fat layers and spindle-shaped bodies for swimming.

questions.subject: Science
questions.chapter: The Living World : Adaptations and Classification
questions.instruction: Read the paragraph and answer the following questions. I am a penguin. I live in polar region covered by snow. My abdomen is white. My skin is thick and a layer of fat underneath. My body is spindle-shaped. My wings are small. My toes are webbed. We live in flocks.
questions.text: (d) Which adaptations should you have to enable you to live permanently in the polar region? Why?
questions.answer: To live in the polar region, one would need a thick layer of fat for insulation, specialized skin or fur to prevent heat loss, and the ability to store energy to survive in a region with scarce food and extreme cold.

questions.subject: Science
questions.chapter: The Living World : Adaptations and Classification
questions.text: (a) Cockroach - I have five legs.
questions.answer: Cockroach is lying. A cockroach is an insect and it has six legs (three pairs).

questions.subject: Science
questions.chapter: The Living World : Adaptations and Classification
questions.text: (b) Hen - My toes are webbed.
questions.answer: Hen is lying. Hens do not have webbed toes; webbed toes are an adaptation found in aquatic birds like ducks for swimming.

questions.subject: Science
questions.chapter: The Living World : Adaptations and Classification
questions.text: (c) Cactus - My fleshy, green part is a leaf.
questions.answer: Cactus is lying. The fleshy green part is actually the stem, which has taken over the function of photosynthesis. The leaves are modified into spines to reduce water loss.

questions.subject: Science
questions.chapter: The Living World : Adaptations and Classification
questions.instruction: Read each of the following statements. Write a paragraph about adaptation with reference to each statement.
questions.text: (a) There is extreme heat in deserts.
questions.answer: Plants like cactus have thick stems to store water and leaves modified into spines to prevent water loss. Animals have thick skin, long legs with padded soles, and stay in burrows during the day to survive the heat.

questions.subject: Science
questions.chapter: The Living World : Adaptations and Classification
questions.instruction: Read each of the following statements. Write a paragraph about adaptation with reference to each statement.
questions.text: (b) Grasslands are lush green.
questions.answer: Grasslands have diverse vegetation. Tall grasses help herbivores like deer to hide from predators. Predators like tigers have padded paws and sharp teeth to hunt in these green areas.

questions.subject: Science
questions.chapter: The Living World : Adaptations and Classification
questions.instruction: Read each of the following statements. Write a paragraph about adaptation with reference to each statement.
questions.text: (c) Insects are found in large numbers.
questions.answer: Insects have adapted to almost every environment. They have light bodies, wings for flight, and protective coloration (camouflage) that allows them to escape predators and reproduce in large numbers.

questions.subject: Science
questions.chapter: The Living World : Adaptations and Classification
questions.instruction: Read each of the following statements. Write a paragraph about adaptation with reference to each statement.
questions.text: (d) We hide.
questions.answer: Hiding is a behavioral adaptation for protection. Many animals use camouflage to blend into their surroundings or live in burrows to stay safe from predators and harsh weather conditions.

questions.subject: Science
questions.chapter: The Living World : Adaptations and Classification
questions.instruction: Read each of the following statements. Write a paragraph about adaptation with reference to each statement.
questions.text: (e) We have long ears.
questions.answer: Animals like rabbits have long ears to detect the slightest sound of predators from a distance. Long ears also help in regulating body temperature by dissipating heat.

questions.subject: Science
questions.chapter: The Living World : Adaptations and Classification
questions.text: (a) Why is the camel called the ‘Ship of the desert’?
questions.answer: The camel is called the 'Ship of the desert' because it has several adaptations like padded feet for walking on sand, a hump to store fat, and the ability to survive for long periods without water, making it the primary mode of transport in deserts.

questions.subject: Science
questions.chapter: The Living World : Adaptations and Classification
questions.text: (b) How can the plants like cactus and acacia live in deserts with scarce water?
questions.answer: These plants have modified leaves into spines to reduce water loss through transpiration. Their stems are fleshy to store water and green to perform photosynthesis. Their roots penetrate deep into the soil to find water.

questions.subject: Science
questions.chapter: The Living World : Adaptations and Classification
questions.text: (c) What is the inter-relationship between adaptations of organisms and their surroundings?
questions.answer: Adaptations are gradual changes in the body parts and behavior of organisms that enable them to live, feed, reproduce, and protect themselves in a specific environment. The surroundings dictate the type of adaptations an organism must develop to survive.

questions.subject: Science
questions.chapter: The Living World : Adaptations and Classification
questions.text: (d) How are organisms classified?
questions.answer: Organisms are classified based on their characteristics using a hierarchy: Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, and Species. Binomial nomenclature (Genus and Species) is used to give each organism a unique scientific name.

questions.subject: Science
questions.chapter: The Living World : Adaptations and Classification
questions.text: Find out how the gradual adaptation from primitive man to modern man must have taken place.
questions.answer: The adaptation from primitive to modern man involved developing bipedalism (walking on two legs), an increase in brain size, the use of tools, and changes in the jaw and teeth structure to accommodate a varied diet.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: What is the function of the root cap?
questions.answer: The root-cap protects the root-tip from injuries.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: Distinguish between reticulate venation and parallel venation with examples.
questions.answer: In reticulate venation, veins form a network or reticulum (e.g., Peepal leaf). In parallel venation, all veins run parallel from the leaf-base to the leaf apex (e.g., Maize leaf).

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: Why are the underground parts of plants like radish, carrot, and beet thick and fleshy?
questions.answer: These are modified roots. They are thick, fleshy, and swollen because they perform the additional function of storing food.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: Describe the structure of the Androecium in a flower.
questions.answer: Androecium is the male reproductive part of the flower. It consists of stamens. Each stamen is made up of an anther and a filament.

questions.text: A student measured the distance between two consecutive nodes on a sugarcane stem as 120 mm. What is this part of the stem called and what is its length?
questions.answer: The part between two nodes is called an internode. Its length is 120 mm.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: Aerial roots, Stilt-roots, Tap roots, Breathing roots.
questions.answer: Tap roots (The others are types of modified roots).

questions.text: Dicotyledonous plants have ______ roots while monocotyledonous plants have fibrous roots.
questions.answer: tap

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: Define 'Stipules'.
questions.answer: Stipules are small leaf-like structures that may be present near the leaf-base.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: What are adventitious roots? Give two examples of plants that have them.
questions.answer: Roots that grow from the stem just above the soil are called adventitious roots. Examples: Maize and Sugarcane.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: Air is a homogeneous mixture of various gases.
questions.answer: Air consists of several gases like nitrogen, oxygen, and carbon dioxide which are mixed uniformly. These components cannot be easily separated by simple physical means, and the mixture exhibits uniform properties throughout.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: Water is a universal solvent.
questions.answer: Water has the ability to dissolve a wide variety of substances, including salts, sugars, and minerals. Because so many substances can dissolve in it, it is known as a universal solvent.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: There is no alternative to water for cleaning purposes.
questions.answer: Water is a universal solvent that can dissolve most dirt and stains. It is also non-toxic, easily available, and safe for cleaning the body, clothes, and utensils without causing chemical damage.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: The amount of water vapour in the air increases.
questions.answer: When water vapour increases, the humidity of the air rises. This makes the surroundings feel damp and sticky, and the rate of evaporation from our skin decreases, making us feel uncomfortable.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: Only one crop is grown repeatedly in the soil.
questions.answer: Growing the same crop repeatedly depletes specific nutrients from the soil, leading to a loss of fertility. It also encourages the buildup of specific pests and diseases associated with that crop.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: With whom should I pair up?
questions.text: Match the items in Group A with Group B.
questions.answer: Air - Scattering of light; Water - Excretion; Soil - Plasticity

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: State whether the following statements are true or false.
questions.text: Sandy soil has low capacity for holding water.
questions.answer: True

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: State whether the following statements are true or false.
questions.text: The substance in which a solute dissolves is called a solvent.
questions.answer: True

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: State whether the following statements are true or false.
questions.text: The pressure exerted by air is called atmospheric pressure.
questions.answer: True

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Write answers to the following questions in your own words.
questions.text: How is light scattered by the air?
questions.answer: Air is a mixture of very fine particles like gases, dust, smoke, and moisture. When sunlight falls on these minute particles, they spread the light in all directions. This phenomenon is known as the scattering of light.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Write answers to the following questions in your own words.
questions.text: Explain the various properties of water.
questions.answer: Water is a fluid substance that exists in three states. It has no shape of its own but has definite volume and mass. It is a universal solvent, shows anomalous expansion, and possesses properties like surface tension and cohesion.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Write answers to the following questions in your own words.
questions.text: Why is the density of seawater more than that of rain water?
questions.answer: Seawater contains a high concentration of dissolved salts and minerals, which increases its mass per unit volume. Rainwater is relatively pure and lacks these dissolved substances, resulting in a lower density compared to seawater.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Write answers to the following questions in your own words.
questions.text: What is the importance of good soil structure?
questions.answer: Good soil structure ensures proper aeration and drainage. It allows plant roots to penetrate easily into the soil, ensuring they receive a sufficient supply of oxygen and nutrients for healthy growth.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Write answers to the following questions in your own words.
questions.text: What are the various uses of soil?
questions.answer: Soil is used for plant conservation (agriculture), water conservation (holding water in bunds/lakes), and as a raw material for making articles like bricks, pots, and statues due to its property of plasticity.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Write answers to the following questions in your own words.
questions.text: What is the need and importance of soil testing from the point of view of farmers?
questions.answer: Soil testing helps farmers determine the proportions of various nutrients and the pH level of the soil. This information is crucial for deciding which crops to plant and which fertilizers are needed to correct deficiencies and improve yield.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Write answers to the following questions in your own words.
questions.text: What is the importance of air in transmission of sound?
questions.answer: Air acts as a medium for the transmission of sound. Sound vibrations travel through the air to reach our ears. In the absence of air, sound cannot travel, and we would not be able to hear anything.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Write answers to the following questions in your own words.
questions.text: Why should a glass bottle completely filled with water never be kept in a freezer?
questions.answer: When water freezes, its volume increases due to anomalous expansion. If a glass bottle is completely filled, the expanding ice exerts immense pressure on the walls of the bottle, which can cause the glass to crack or burst.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: Classify the following organisms according to their food-type: tiger, cow, vulture, bacteria, deer, goat, human, fungus, lion, sparrow, buffalo, frog, cockroach, tick.
questions.answer: Herbivores: cow, deer, goat, buffalo; Carnivores: tiger, lion, frog; Scavengers: vulture; Decomposers: bacteria, fungus; Omnivores: human, sparrow, cockroach; Parasites: tick.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: Match the plants in Group 'A' with their types in Group 'B'.
questions.answer: Parasitic plant - Cuscuta, Insectivorous plant - Drosera, Saprophytic plant - Mushroom, Symbiotic plant - Lichen

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Answer the following questions in your own words.
questions.text: Why do living organisms need nutrition?
questions.answer: Living organisms need nutrition to supply energy for work, for growth and development, to replace damaged cells and repair tissues, and to fight diseases.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Answer the following questions in your own words.
questions.text: Explain the process of production of food in plants.
questions.answer: Plants produce food through photosynthesis. Using sunlight and chlorophyll, they convert carbon dioxide from the air and water from the soil into glucose, releasing oxygen as a byproduct.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Answer the following questions in your own words.
questions.text: What is meant by parasitic plants? Name their different types with examples of each.
questions.answer: Parasitic plants grow on other plants for nutrition. Types include Holoparasitic plants (e.g., Cuscuta) which depend entirely on the host, and Hemiparasitic plants (e.g., Loranthus) which produce their own food but take water and minerals from the host.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Answer the following questions in your own words.
questions.text: Explain the various steps of nutrition in animals.
questions.answer: The steps are: 1. Ingestion (taking food in), 2. Digestion (conversion to soluble form), 3. Absorption (transfer to blood), 4. Assimilation (utilization by cells), and 5. Egestion (removal of waste).

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Answer the following questions in your own words.
questions.text: Name some unicellular organisms in which all life-processes take place within their unicellular body.
questions.answer: Amoeba, Euglena, Paramoecium.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: Insectivorous plants are attractively coloured.
questions.answer: They are attractively coloured to attract insects. They trap and digest these insects to fulfill their nitrogen requirement, as they usually grow in soil deficient in nitrogen.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: Butterflies have a long tube-like proboscis.
questions.answer: Butterflies have a long tube-like proboscis to suck nectar from flowers, which is their primary source of liquid food.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Prepare and complete the flowchart according to type of nutrition.
questions.text: In the given figure, complete the missing boxes in the flowchart based on the types of nutrition in plants and animals.
questions.answer: Plants: Autotrophic, Heterotrophic (Insectivorous, Saprophytic). Animals: Holozoic, Saprozoic, Parasitic (Ectoparasitic, Endoparasitic).

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: We prepare a variety of foodstuffs and dishes at home. Are we then autotrophic organisms?
questions.answer: No, we are not autotrophic. We only cook or process food obtained from plants and animals. Autotrophs like plants produce their own food from inorganic sources like CO2 and water using sunlight.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: Which organisms are greater in number - autotrophs or heterotrophs? Why?
questions.answer: Autotrophs are greater in number because they are the primary producers. They form the base of the food chain and must be numerous enough to support all the heterotrophs that depend on them.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: The number of heterotrophs found in desert regions is smaller. However, they are found in greater numbers in the sea. Why is this so?
questions.answer: Deserts have scarce water and vegetation (producers), limiting the food supply for heterotrophs. The sea has abundant water and a massive population of producers like algae and phytoplankton, supporting more heterotrophs.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: What damage or harm do ectoparasitic and endoparasitic animals cause?
questions.answer: Ectoparasites suck blood and cause skin irritation or spread diseases. Endoparasites live inside the body, consume the host's nutrients, and can cause internal organ damage, malnutrition, or serious illnesses.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: Why is plant food not produced in any other parts of the plant except the green ones?
questions.answer: Food production (photosynthesis) requires chlorophyll to trap solar energy. Chlorophyll is only present in the green parts of the plant, such as leaves and young stems.

questions.answer: pasteurization

questions.answer: natural

questions.instruction: Complete the following statement by using the correct option from those given below. (Irradiation, dehydration, pasteurization, natural, chemical)

questions.answer: chemical

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Answer the following question in your own words.
questions.text: How is milk pasteurized?
questions.answer: Milk is heated to a specific temperature (e.g., 80°C for 15 minutes) and then cooled quickly. This process destroys the microorganisms present in the milk and increases its shelf life.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Answer the following question in your own words.
questions.text: Why should we not consume adulterated food materials?
questions.answer: Adulterated food can cause various health problems like food poisoning, stomach disorders, and long-term effects on organs. It reduces the nutritional value and can be toxic.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Answer the following question in your own words.
questions.text: What precautions do your parents take to keep foodstuffs safe?
questions.answer: Precautions include drying grains before storage, keeping perishables like milk and vegetables in the refrigerator, using airtight containers, and checking expiry dates before use.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Answer the following question in your own words.
questions.text: How does food spoilage occur? Which are the various factors spoiling the food?
questions.answer: Food spoilage occurs due to internal chemical changes or external factors. Factors include microorganisms (bacteria, fungi), insects, moisture, temperature, and improper handling or storage.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Answer the following question in your own words.
questions.text: Which methods of food preservation would you use?
questions.answer: I would use methods like freezing, drying (dehydration), boiling, pasteurization, and using natural or chemical preservatives depending on the type of food.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: There are vendors selling uncovered sweetmeats in open places in the market.
questions.answer: We should avoid buying such food as it may be contaminated with dust and flies. We should also advise the vendor to keep the food covered.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: A 'pani-puriwalla' is serving the pani puri with dirty hands.
questions.answer: We should not eat there and politely ask the vendor to wash his hands or use gloves to maintain hygiene and prevent the spread of diseases.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: We have purchased a large quantity of fruits and vegetables.
questions.answer: We should store them properly in a refrigerator or a cool, dry place. Perishable items should be used first, and some can be preserved by making pickles or jams.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: We need to protect foodstuffs from pests like rats, cockroaches, wall-lizards, etc.
questions.answer: We should store food in airtight, sturdy containers, keep the kitchen clean, and use safe pest control methods to prevent access to the food.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: salt, vinegar, citric acid, sodium benzoate
questions.answer: salt (It is a natural preservative, while others are chemical preservatives.)

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: lakhi dal, brick dust, metanyl yellow, turmeric powder
questions.answer: turmeric powder (It is a food item, while others are common adulterants.)

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: banana, apple, guava, almond
questions.answer: almond (It is a dry fruit with low moisture, while others are fleshy fruits with high moisture content.)

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: storing, freezing, settling, drying
questions.answer: settling (It is not a standard food preservation method, while others are.)

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: Foodstuff: ______ | Adulterant: Metanyl yellow
questions.answer: Turmeric powder

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: Foodstuff: Black pepper | Adulterant: ______
questions.answer: Papaya seeds

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: Foodstuff: ______ | Adulterant: Iron filings
questions.answer: Rava (Semolina)

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: Foodstuff: Honey | Adulterant: ______
questions.answer: Sugar syrup / Jaggery syrup

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Explain why this happens and suggest possible remedies.
questions.text: Qualitative wastage of food.
questions.answer: This happens due to wrong methods of protecting food, excessive use of preservatives, or over-washing vegetables. Remedy: Use proper preservation techniques and avoid over-processing.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Explain why this happens and suggest possible remedies.
questions.text: The cooked rice is underdone.
questions.answer: This happens due to insufficient water or heat during cooking. Remedy: Add a little more water and cook for a few more minutes on low heat.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Explain why this happens and suggest possible remedies.
questions.text: The wheat that was bought is a bit moist.
questions.answer: This happens due to improper storage or exposure to rain. Remedy: Dry the wheat thoroughly in the sun before storing it in a dry container.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Explain why this happens and suggest possible remedies.
questions.text: The taste of yoghurt is too sour/slightly bitter.
questions.answer: This happens due to over-fermentation or spoilage by bacteria. Remedy: Store yoghurt in the refrigerator and consume it fresh; discard if it tastes bitter.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Explain why this happens and suggest possible remedies.
questions.text: Cut fruits have turned black.
questions.answer: This happens due to a chemical reaction (oxidation) with air. Remedy: Consume fruits immediately after cutting or sprinkle a little lemon juice on them to prevent browning.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: Food remains safe at 5° Celsius.
questions.answer: At low temperatures like 5°C, the biological and chemical reactions in food materials are slowed down, and the growth of microorganisms is inhibited, keeping food safe.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: Nowadays, food is served buffet style during large gatherings.
questions.answer: Buffet style helps in reducing quantitative food wastage as people take only as much food as they want to eat, compared to traditional sit-down service.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: Go to your kitchen and take notes about the food safety measures and the food wastage you see there.
questions.answer: Student should observe storage (fridge, containers), cleaning habits, and identify if any food is thrown away due to spoilage or excess.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: In a science exhibition demonstrate the various methods of detecting food adulteration.
questions.answer: Demonstrate tests like adding water to milk (flow test), using a magnet for rava, or adding HCl to turmeric to check for metanyl yellow.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Write answer to the following question in your own words.
questions.text: Why is the weight of the same object different on different planets?
questions.answer: Weight is the gravitational force that the earth (or a planet) exerts on an object. Since the gravitational force varies from planet to planet, the weight of the same object is different on different planets.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Write answer to the following question in your own words.
questions.text: What precautions will you take to make accurate measurements in day-to-day affairs?
questions.answer: Precautions include: 1. Using standardized weights and measures. 2. Checking if the balance has the government seal of verification. 3. Ensuring the balance is stable and the pointer is at zero. 4. Checking if the underside of the pan has been tampered with.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Write answer to the following question in your own words.
questions.text: What is the difference between mass and weight?
questions.answer: Mass is the amount of matter present in an object; it is a scalar quantity and remains the same everywhere. Weight is the gravitational force acting on this mass; it is a vector quantity and changes depending on the gravitational pull of the location.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Who is my companion? Match the pairs from Group 'A' and Group 'B'.
questions.text: Match the physical quantities with their correct units.
questions.answer: Velocity - metre/second; Area - square metre; Volume - litre; Mass - kilogram; Density - kilogram/cubic metre

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: Scalar quantity
questions.answer: A quantity that can be completely expressed by its magnitude alone is called a scalar quantity. Examples: Length, breadth, area, mass, temperature, density, time, work.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: Vector quantity
questions.answer: The quantity that is expressed completely only when both magnitude and direction are given is called a vector quantity. Examples: Displacement, velocity.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Explain, giving examples, the errors that occur while making measurements.
questions.text: Explain the major causes of errors in measurement with examples.
questions.answer: Major errors include: 1. Not using the appropriate device (e.g., using a hand-span instead of a ruler). 2. Not using the device properly (e.g., not aligning the scale to zero). 3. Using unstandardized weights or measures in the market.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: It is not proper to measure quantities by using body parts as units.
questions.answer: Body parts like hand-spans or cubits vary in size from person to person. Therefore, measurements taken using body parts are not standardized and cannot be used for accurate or universal measurement.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: It is necessary to get the weights and measures standardized at regular intervals.
questions.answer: Standardization is necessary to ensure accuracy in trade and prevent consumers from being cheated. Regular checks by the weights and measures department ensure that the devices have not been tampered with or worn out.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Explain the need for accurate measurement and the devices to be used for that.
questions.text: Why is accurate measurement necessary and which devices are used for it?
questions.answer: Accuracy is essential for measuring precious substances, goods used in small quantities, and for scientific research. Devices used include digital balances for mass, thermometers for temperature, and standardized rulers or tapes for length.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: Collect information about various physical quantities used in day-to-day life and the devices used for their measurement.
questions.answer: Student should list quantities like mass (vegetables), volume (milk), temperature (body/weather), and time, along with devices like beam balances, measuring cylinders, thermometers, and clocks.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Fill in the blanks with the proper words from the brackets. (stationary, zero, changing, constant, displacement, velocity, speed, acceleration, stationary but not zero, increases)
questions.text: If a body traverses a distance in direct proportion to the time, the speed of the body is ______.
questions.answer: constant

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Fill in the blanks with the proper words from the brackets. (stationary, zero, changing, constant, displacement, velocity, speed, acceleration, stationary but not zero, increases)
questions.text: If a body is moving with a constant velocity its acceleration is ______.
questions.answer: zero

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Fill in the blanks with the proper words from the brackets. (stationary, zero, changing, constant, displacement, velocity, speed, acceleration, stationary but not zero, increases)
questions.text: ______ is a scalar quantity.
questions.answer: speed

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Fill in the blanks with the proper words from the brackets. (stationary, zero, changing, constant, displacement, velocity, speed, acceleration, stationary but not zero, increases)
questions.text: ______ is the distance traversed by a body in a particular direction in unit time.
questions.answer: velocity

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Observe the figure and answer the questions.
questions.text: Sachin and Sameer started on a motorbike from place A, took the turn at B, did a task at C, travelled by the route CD to D and then went on to E. Altogether, they took one hour for this journey. Find out the actual distance traversed by them and the displacement from A to E. From this, deduce their speed. What was their velocity from A to E in the direction AE? Can this velocity be called average velocity?
questions.answer: Distance is the sum of paths AB+BC+CD+DE. Displacement is the straight line distance AE. Speed = Total Distance / Total Time. Velocity = Displacement / Time. Yes, this velocity is called average velocity as it considers total displacement over total time.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: From the groups B and C, choose the proper words, for each of the words in group A.
questions.text: Match the physical quantities with their SI and CGS units.
questions.answer: Work: Joule (SI), erg (CGS); Force: Newton (SI), dyne (CGS); Displacement: Metre (SI), cm (CGS)

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: A bird sitting on a wire, flies, circles around and comes back to its perch. Explain the total distance it traversed during its flight and its eventual displacement.
questions.answer: The total distance is the actual length of the circular path the bird flew. The displacement is zero because the bird's starting point and ending point are the same.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Explain the following concept in your own words with everyday examples.
questions.text: Force
questions.answer: Force is an interaction that changes the state of rest or motion of an object. Example: Pushing a stalled car to make it move.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Explain the following concept in your own words with everyday examples.
questions.text: Work
questions.answer: Work is said to be done when a force applied on an object causes displacement of the object. Example: Lifting a school bag from the floor to a desk.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Explain the following concept in your own words with everyday examples.
questions.text: Displacement
questions.answer: Displacement is the minimum distance traversed by a moving body in one direction from the original point to the reaching point. Example: The straight-line distance between home and school.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Explain the following concept in your own words with everyday examples.
questions.text: Velocity
questions.answer: Velocity is the distance traversed by a body in a specific direction in unit time. Example: A train traveling at 80 km/h towards the North.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Explain the following concept in your own words with everyday examples.
questions.text: Acceleration
questions.answer: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity. Example: A bike increasing its speed when the rider turns the accelerator.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Explain the following concept in your own words with everyday examples.
questions.text: Distance
questions.answer: Distance is the length of the actual path traversed by a body in motion while going from one point to another. Example: The total path covered by a person walking through a winding park trail.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: A ball is rolling from A to D on a flat and smooth surface. Its speed is 2cm/s. On reaching B, it was pushed continuously up to C. On reaching D from C, its speed had become 4cm/s. It took 2 seconds for it to go from B to C. What is the acceleration of the ball as it goes from B to C?
questions.answer: Initial velocity (u) = 2 cm/s, Final velocity (v) = 4 cm/s, Time (t) = 2 s. Acceleration (a) = (v - u) / t = (4 - 2) / 2 = 2 / 2 = 1 cm/s².

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: A force of 1000N was applied to stop a car that was moving with a constant velocity. The car stopped after moving through 10m. How much is the work done?
questions.answer: Force (F) = 1000 N, Displacement (s) = 10 m. Work (W) = F × s = 1000 × 10 = 10,000 Joules.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: A cart with mass 20 kg went 50m in a straight line on a plain and smooth road when a force of 2N was applied to it. How much work was done by the force?
questions.answer: Force (F) = 2 N, Displacement (s) = 50 m. Work (W) = F × s = 2 × 50 = 100 Joules.

questions.subject: Science
questions.text: Collect information about the study made by Sir Isaac Newton regarding force and acceleration and discuss it with your teacher.
